newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Fin'l seeks to sell GNMA rights.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Fin'l seeks to sell GNMA rights.

text.p: Advanced Financial Inc said it asked the Government National Mortgage Association (GNMA) for approval to sell to a third party its mortgage servicing rights to a portfolio in which GNMA is the investor.

The servicing rights represent Advanced Financial's only remaining significant asset. Under the currently proposed terms, the company expects having a shortage of about $350,000 to $400,000 in its custodial accounts for the mortgages.
The company also said its board is examining alternatives to address its troubled financial state, including selling the company or merging with another company.
